title: plan-return-v1
description: Schema for Worker-written plan-returns/<run_id>/<plan_id>/plan-return.json. Source of truth for the Plan-level envelope produced by pack-executor / complex-pack-executor in autonomous mode (Plan 005). Read by agent-return-handler hook on SubagentStop to drive verdict routing (pass / partial-pass / blocked / need-fresh-worker / needs-context / needs-plan-revision). Sibling artifacts in the same directory: doc-patch.diff (plan checkbox patch, applied by Coordinator after Plan Implementation Review passes — Decision 6) and open-items.json (accumulated open items across packs).

run_id.description: Run identifier — must match the active run.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of Worker dispatch start.

verdict.description: Plan-level verdict. Drives agent-return-handler routing: pass / partial-pass → Plan Implementation Review (doc-patch NOT yet applied); blocked → BLOCKED route; need-fresh-worker → Coordinator dispatches new Agent with resume_from_pack_id; needs-context / needs-plan-revision → routed back to plan-writing / discovery.

status.description: committed = pack TDD + verification passed and commit landed; blocked = three-failure protocol exhausted; skipped = pack pre-empted (e.g. need-fresh-worker break before reaching it).

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the Pack commit (only when status=committed).

verdict.description: Per-pack verdict surfaced in pack-returns/<pack_id>.json (e.g. 'pass', 'needs repair'). Mirrored here for fast lookup.

reason.description: When status=blocked or skipped, short reason text.

attempts.description: Number of TDD attempts before blocked (for diagnostics).

doc_patch_path.description: Relative path to doc-patch.diff — typically 'plan-returns/<run_id>/<plan_id>/doc-patch.diff'. Decision 6: NOT applied at handler time; Coordinator applies after Plan Implementation Review passes.

completed_packs.description: How many packs this Worker session committed before returning.

triggered.description: True when packs_in_session >= 5 AND remaining_packs >= 2 — verdict will be need-fresh-worker.

repair_round.description: Repair Mode marker: 0/null on initial dispatch, >=1 when SendMessage repair triggered this return.

concerns.description: Free-form Worker concerns the reviewer should see.
